editorial:
Ever felt like your love life was a total mess? You will relate to the characters here. You get to follow four people who are all lying to each other in the most awkward ways possible. You have Michel and Juliette, who just split up because Michel cheated with a younger woman. Then there are Alice and Nicolas, who seem fine on the surface, but Alice is secretly seeing a hot photographer. It is a sneaky, funny look at how people handle cheating and secrets, and the vibe feels like a lighthearted game of romantic musical chairs where nobody really knows where they stand.

What really works is how the movie keeps you guessing about who will get caught first. The acting feels natural, and the pacing moves along quickly so you never get bored. While some of the drama might feel a bit repetitive, the payoff is worth it. If you enjoy stories about complicated relationships and funny mishaps, you should definitely check this out. You can grab a 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection if you like owning movies, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up when all the secret affairs finally collide. The lies catch up to everyone, leading to a series of honest but messy confrontations. Instead of a traditional happy ending, the characters are forced to face the truth about their partners. Some couples break apart for good, while others realize they are too tired to keep lying. It ends with a sense of relief as the secrets are gone, leaving them to figure out their lives alone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies with a twist of drama.
